positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what distinguishes intelligence you own from intelligence you rent, and how is that distinction being positioned for a downstream extractor?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under one directional read: src-1 draws the owned/rented distinction, src-2 restates it as substrate-commodity versus perspective-asset, and src-3 explicitly names the individually-owned-intelligence thesis and its purpose — giving a navigating extractor existing positioning to connect to. The shared stance is a settled, calm assertion of self-origination value performed through matched-opposition maxims, with src-3 providing the meta-scaffolding that names what the first two enact. No tension across the set; src-3 is the self-aware framing of what src-1 and src-2 do.
